31924-XII.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) and the budget statement for its operating-cost services (KNMI, RWS, IVW), as the 2008 Slotwet adjustment. It sets out technical and accounting budget changes, with amounts in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 31 December 2008.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

32565-VII.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII), adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenues for the policy articles and the baten-lastendiensten following the Najaarsnota. It also sets the entry-into-force date of 1 December 2010 and the retroactivity rule for later publication.
q: We ... have found and decided ... that the need has arisen to amend the budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2010

Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2010

33000-XVI.s: The bill formally establishes the 2012 departmental budget (XVI) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the 2012 budgets of five baten-lasten agencies (CBG, CIBG, RIVM, two Jeugdzorg Plus institutions). It sets appropriations in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2012 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) belonging to this act for the year 2012 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33090-XV.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (departmental budget and baten-lastendiensten budget) by adjusting appropriations and commitments across programmes, effective from 1 December 2011. It delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power towards the executive; it is a routine supplementary budget adjustment.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33240-VIII.s: This bill enacts the 2011 final budget adjustment (slotwet) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the baten-lastendiensten DUO and Nationaal Archief, approving the revised budget figures in thousands of euros. It also creates a multi-year budget reserve under the Ministry General article to cover state guarantees for residual debt of education institutions that default on loans.
q: Notwithstanding Article 5(4) of the Comptability Act 2001, a multi-year budget reserve charged to non-policy article Ministry General (article number 18) is maintained for 2011.

In afwijking van artikel 5, vierde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt voor het jaar 2011 een meerjarige begrotingsreserve ten laste van het niet-beleidsartikel Ministerie Algemeen (artikelnummer 18) aangehouden.

33400-XIII.s: This bill formally adopts the 2013 budget statements (departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the balance statements for its operational services), in thousands of euros, and sets the entry-into-force rule. The explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities and operational plans without introducing new executive discretion beyond the budget itself.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2013 is hereby adopted.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33805-XII.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII), adjusting appropriations across policy and non-policy articles following the Najaarsnota. It takes effect from 1 December 2013, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: We ... have resolved that the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) for 2013 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd

33906-(R2030).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 30 October 2009 amendment to Article 6 of the 1996 Protocol to the 1972 London Convention on dumping of waste at sea. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: is approved for the entire Kingdom
wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk

33940-XII.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, adjusting commitment and expenditure appropriations across policy articles via a first supplementary budget. It also records the transfer of Interbestuurlijk Toezicht tasks to the provinces and the moving of ministers' salary administration to the Ministry of Interior.
33940-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need for a budget amendment and the policy adjustments set out in the Voorjaarsnota 2014, with no explicit justification for new executive powers.
q: The tasks surrounding Interbestuurlijk Toezicht are transferred to the provinces.
De taken rondom het Interbestuurlijk Toezicht worden aan de provincies overgedragen
p: Budget amendments are adopted by the Staten-Generaal, while the memorandum notes that Interbestuurlijk Toezicht tasks are transferred to the provinces, shifting oversight functions to subnational government.

34009-(R2035).s: The bill makes binding EU restrictive measures adopted under the Common Foreign and Security Policy directly applicable in Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, with exceptions for measures binding only member states or EU bodies. It obliges the three countries to take the measures needed to implement these EU sanctions and to be involved in the Netherlands' position-forming on such decisions.
34009-(R2035).j: The memorandum justifies the approach by the unity of the Kingdom's foreign relations and by limiting the legislative burden on the countries to supervision and enforcement provisions.
q: By implementing a European Regulation that contains the content of a resolution, that resolution is thus 'automatically included'.
Door implementatie van een Europese Verordening waarin de inhoud van een resolutie is vervat, is de desbetreffende resolutie immers «automatisch meegenomen».
d: authorities designated to implement EU sanctions in the three countries
p: EU sanctions instruments become directly applicable in the three countries and displace conflicting national legislation without parliamentary enactment there.

parties: Objects that the bill overrides Curaçao's existing sanctions ordinance and autonomy, and that Curaçao was insufficiently consulted in preparing the bill.
This existing national ordinance is simply set aside by the bill of rijkswet.
Deze vigerende landsverordening wordt door het voorstel van rijkswet zomaar opzij gezet.
Accepts that Curaçao must share the burdens of Kingdom membership, while regretting the lack of thorough preparation and the Curaçao legislature's failure to regulate the matter itself.
It is a pity that Curaçao does not form one bloc with other countries in this context.
Het is jammer dat Curaçao in dit verband niet één blok vormt met andere landen.
Can accept the bill as opposing terrorism is undisputed, while regretting that the Staten let the chance to regulate it by landsverordening pass.
The PAR faction can agree with the present bill of rijkswet.
De PAR-fractie kan zich vinden in het onderhavige voorstel van rijkswet.

Condemns the procedure as contrary to the Statute because autonomous countries took no joint position, and warns that adopting EU sanctions could harm Curaçao's interests; follows the Raad van Advies.
Like other factions, the PS faction points to the lack of a joint position by the autonomous countries, so the Statute was violated.
Evenals andere fracties, wijst de PS-fractie op het gebrek aan standpuntbepaling door de autonome landen, waardoor hiermee is gehandeld in strijd met het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk.

Objects to the arrogant manner of imposing the bill, argues it is a Kingdom matter requiring Rijksministerraad consultation before binding Curaçao, and insists Statute articles 25-27 must not be violated.
The MAN faction cannot allow articles 25, 26 and 27 of the Statute for the Kingdom to be violated and sincerely hopes this will not happen.
De MAN-fractie kan niet toestaan dat de artikelen 25, 26 en 27 van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk worden geschonden en hoopt ten zeerste niet dat dit zal gebeuren.

Supports fighting terrorism and implementing the sanctions, but argues Curaçao as an autonomous country should itself choose to implement them and regrets that a 'may' provision was not adopted; plans an amendment reflecting the Raad van Advies.
The PAIS faction believes that we as an autonomous country must ourselves choose to implement these sanctions.
De PAIS-fractie vindt dat wij als autonoom land zelf moeten kiezen om deze sancties uit te voeren.
Asks how implementation differs per country, who designates the competent authorities, and why there is no single Kingdom-wide authority.
They wonder whether it is possible for each country separately to determine which parts of the law enter into force?
Zij vragen zich af of het mogelijk is voor elk Land afzonderlijk te bepalen welke onderdelen van de wet in werking treden?

Supports Kingdom-wide implementation in principle but presses on whether Curaçao was properly involved and whether the statutory procedure was followed, and asks about the Caribbean countries' capacity.
Was the correct procedure followed, as set out in the Statute?
Is de juiste procedure gevolgd, zoals opgenomen in het Statuut?
Supports the bill as necessary to preserve the unity of Kingdom foreign policy since the Curaçao parliament did not amend its ordinance.

Where measures are taken by the EU for maintaining or restoring international peace and security, or combating terrorism, it cannot be that the Netherlands implements European sanctions while the Caribbean countries do not.

Als het gaat om maatregelen die de EU neemt, met het oog op handhaving of herstel van de internationale vrede en veiligheid of de bevordering van de internationale rechtsorde dan wel de bestrijding van terrorisme, kan het niet zo zijn dat Nederland wel uitvoering geeft aan Europese sancties en de landen in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk niet.

Objects to the procedure, citing the Raad van State and Curaçao's advisory council that the Caribbean countries were not sufficiently involved, and asks about legal protection and compensation for affected firms.
It is not known how the countries were involved in preparing this decision, and therefore it is also not known to what extent they can agree with it.
Niet bekend is op welke wijze de landen betrokken zijn bij de voorbereiding van dit besluit en dus ook niet in hoeverre zij zich hierin kunnen vinden.
Asks whether the bill does justice to all Kingdom countries and whether the current process, sidelining Curaçao, is desirable.
The said members ask the government whether it considers the current process, in which Curaçao has de facto been sidelined, desirable.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of zij het huidige proces, waarbij Curaçao de-facto buitenspel is gezet, wenselijk acht.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom supports the aim of the draft Rijkssanctiewet to apply EU sanctions across the whole Kingdom, but asks for clearer justification, scope clarification (including Article 215 TFEU, existing sanctions, and the 'in deviation of other legal provisions' wording), a better explanation of how EU sanctions take effect in Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and clarification of the added value of Article 3. The government's nader rapport largely accepts these points: it clarifies scope and transitional rules, explains that Article 3 operationalises the consultation duty, and keeps the phased-introduction wording in Article 4 only partly followed.
concerns: The Afdeling accepts that uniform application across the Kingdom is necessary for sanctions effectiveness but asks for better justification of the choice of Article 3(1)(b) Statuut and for explanation of the geopolitical differences affecting the Caribbean countries.

Scope of Article 1 is unclear: it omits measures under Article 215(1) and 215(2) TFEU on non-state groups, does not clarify whether existing sanctions apply, and the 'in deviation of other legal provisions' wording lacks explained consequences; the government clarified scope and transitional rules.

Because the overseas countries are LGO territories where only Part Four TFEU applies, EU sanctions do not take effect automatically; the explanatory memorandum must explain how EU sanctions are given effect, including consequences of amendments, withdrawals, legal remedies and data exchange.

The Afdeling asks for clarification of the added value of Article 3 beyond the existing consultation guarantees of Statuut Article 11(3) and 27; the government explains it operationalises the consultation duty and the Afdeling's point is accepted in the memorandum.
The redactional note on Article 4 (deleting 'voor de invoering van de verschillende artikelen of onderdelen') was not adopted because the phased introduction wording is needed.

34141-(R2047).s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval (rijkswet) for the Nagoya Protocol on access to genetic resources and fair benefit-sharing, so that the Kingdom can be bound by it. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies across the whole Kingdom.
q: The Nagoya Protocol contains no rules on what a fair and equitable sharing of benefits is.
Het Nagoya Protocol behelst geen regels over wat een eerlijke en billijke verdeling van voordelen is.

34210-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statutes for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, its agencies, and the Animal Health Fund through the first supplementary budget. It changes appropriations, revenues and expenditure lines and sets the amended figures in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2015.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII)

34300-XIII.s: This bill fixes the 2016 budget appropriations for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, its agencies and the Animal Health Fund, in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum sets out spending and revenue priorities, agency funding and policy evaluations rather than delegating rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2016 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34620-XV.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget statute of its agency, adjusting appropriations and revenues in thousands of euros following the Najaarsnota. It makes the amended budget statutes effective from 1 December 2016, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statute attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34725-VII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement of its agency RvIG, adjusting appropriations and realisations as a closing budget law (Slotwet). It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no oversight changes; the explanatory memorandum extract is empty.

34950-VII.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (Chapter VII) and the budget statement of its agency RvIG, adjusting appropriations to realised figures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum beyond a note that none was found.

35200-XIII.s: This slotwet (final adjustment law) approves changes to the 2018 budget statements of the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agency budgets, and the Animal Health Fund. It records realised spending, revenue and closing differences, and the memorandum explains reserve movements and the Groningen programme without granting new executive rule-making powers.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2018 (Final Adjustment Act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2018 (Slotwet)

35470-XII.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2019 budget statements of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, its agencies (Rijkswaterstaat, ILT, KNMI) and the budget fund, by approving budget changes in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, only budget appropriations and a standard entry-into-force clause.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35650-XII.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and the budget statement for its executive agencies, a second supplementary budget. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2020.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35830-XII.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (Slotwet) for 2020 that amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the budgets of its agencies RWS, ILT and KNMI to reflect realised spending. The explanatory memorandum reports budget reallocations and realisation differences across policy articles, without delegating rule-making power.
q: With the Slotwet, €0.68 million was transferred from the reservation for the 2020 home-working allowance under article 99 to the ILT personnel budget under article 24.
Bij de Slotwet is € 0,68 miljoen overgeboekt van de reservering voor de thuiswerkvergoeding 2020 op artikel 99 naar het personeelsbudget van de ILT op artikel 24.

35850-VII.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) by reallocating funds across budget articles, effective the day after publication and retroactive to 1 June 2021. The explanatory memorandum covers budget adjustments for housing, energy transition, democracy subsidies and the Groningen programme, without delegating rule-making or shifting oversight powers.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2021
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2021

36100-XIII.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budget statement for its agencies to reflect realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36120-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the 2022 budget of the agency DUO (Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs), with the changes taking effect from 1 June 2022. The explanatory memorandum describes the reallocations for teacher pay, vocational education, the Nationaal Groeifonds and student finance, but it does not delegate rule-making or shift powers away from parliament or courts.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) and the budget of the agency DUO, all for the year 2022;

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) en de begrotingsstaat inzake agentschap DUO, alle voor het jaar 2022;

36435-VII.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, mainly by shifting several hundred million euros across policy articles such as housing, energy transition and the central organisation. It is a supplementary budget bill and sets the amounts in thousands of euros with retroactive effect to 19 September 2023.
q: The 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36550-XII.s: This first supplementary budget for 2024 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the budgets of its executive agencies (Rijkswaterstaat and KNMI), shifting funds between policy articles and postponing spending to later years. It is a budget adjustment with no new statutory powers for the executive.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (XII), and of the budget statement on the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2024

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII), en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2024

36600-XV.s: This bill fixes the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment at roughly EUR 59.8 billion in expenditure, in thousands of euros, and takes effect on 1 January 2025. The accompanying explanatory memorandum excerpt describes spending, evaluation plans and implementation of social security, benefits and labour policy, without delegating new rule-making powers to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2025 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it had no remarks on the draft budget statute (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for 2025 and recommended submitting it to the House of Representatives. The government's nader rapport confirms this blank advice and reports technical adjustments to expenditure and receipts following updated Central Planning Bureau figures.

36613-XII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the agencies budget, via a September supplementary budget with revised spending and commitment amounts across policy articles. It also makes technical adjustments such as moving funds to the ILT for taxi onboard computer inspections and deferring ICT investment spending.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for 2024 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd

36820-XII.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and the agency budgets, with a supplementary budget for September 2025, effective retroactively to 16 September 2025. The memorandum explains the increased ICT and staffing costs of the ILT supervisory body linked to the ERTMS rollout and rail digitalisation.
36820-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need for additional capacity and ICT costs for the ILT supervisory body to fulfil its role during rail digitalisation.
q: The rollout of ERTMS and the digitalisation of the railways is a complex change task affecting the entire rail sector in the Netherlands.
De uitrol van ERTMS en de digitalisering van het spoor is een complexe veranderopgave die een impact heeft voor de volledige spoorbranche in Nederland.
